This guide addresses how to leverage Supabase as the order database for your digital store, ensuring you can accept crypto payments effortlessly and independently. You will learn to deploy a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-github-pages-free-digital-product-4|infrastructure]] that empowers you to maintain full ownership of your assets and data without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The limitations of conventional payment processors are starkly evident in regions where they are unavailable or unreliable. COREMERCH's infrastructure, specifically Stack 01 and Stack 02, provides a resilient solution that fully circumvents these issues. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you effectively establish a sovereign e-commerce presence. This infrastructure not only allows for seamless transactions but also ensures that you own everything from the start, preserving your autonomy as a digital creator.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you embark on deploying your digital store using Supabase, ensure you have the essential tools at hand. For Stack 01, you'll need a GitHub account for hosting, access to Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with Supabase as your order database; it is crucial for managing product orders and customer interactions. Additionally, prepare your digital products and their delivery mechanisms, which can be facilitated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying your backend using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. This will handle incoming requests and process payments via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Once the backend is operational, configure your Supabase database to store order details securely. Finally, ensure your products are hosted in Google Drive or a similar service, allowing for immediate access post-purchase to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline delivery.
Own your data and infrastructure without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your digital store set up, it's time to go live. Begin by testing your payment processing on the mainnet to confirm that everything functions as intended. Initiate a test purchase with a small amount to verify that the payment flows seamlessly through NOWPayments, and that order details are correctly stored in your Supabase database. Once you've confirmed that your transaction processes correctly and product delivery is automated, you are ready to promote your store to your audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is live and operational, consider how to scale your digital store efficiently. Begin by expanding your product offerings to maximize the potential for sales. Utilize analytics from your Supabase database to understand customer behavior and adjust your marketing efforts accordingly. As you grow, consider upgrading to Stack 02 for enhanced performance and capabilities, which includes additional products and advanced configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup to improve your store’s email deliverability.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Transition to a resilient commerce model that withstands payment processor failures.

Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Supabase offers a scalable and secure order database solution that integrates seamlessly with your digital store. It allows for efficient management of customer orders and data, ensuring you maintain operational sovereignty.
